title: IMF Concludes 2026 Article IV Mission — Flags Inflation and Fiscal Consolidation Risks
detail: The International Monetary Fund released its Staff Concluding Statement of the 2026 Article IV Mission on Chile on May 4, 2026, providing an authoritative external assessment of the country's economic performance under the new Kast administration. The IMF's statement acknowledged Chile's relatively strong fundamentals — deep capital markets, sound banking system, and structural copper revenues — while flagging that recent fuel price shocks posed short-term inflationary risks and that planned fiscal consolidation needed to be carefully sequenced to avoid damping recovery. The IMF highlighted that Chile's lithium export revenue surge offered a structural opportunity to strengthen the sovereign wealth framework but that social pressures (pension adequacy, inequality) remained significant medium-term risks to political stability.

media.caption: IMF 2026 Article IV Mission on Chile highlights inflation risks and lithium revenue opportunity
